1496-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
1496-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

3490-4359-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4359-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

586-728-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

323-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4498-7839.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each player and creature.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

813-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3375-4399-4770-6823.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1003-4336-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-4336-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

670-1619-6135-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6135-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Aarakocra Sneak to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

1251-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1251-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1251-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

513-527-7730.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-7730.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5315-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1805-4067-5181-6281.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-1322-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1322-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1645-5334-5954-6763.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

856-2267-3967-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-3967-4321.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

803-3951-4050-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
803-3951-4050-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2423-2532-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2423-2532-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Bounding Krasis tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-3129-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

526-1090-1692.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Restoration Angel.
You control at least one nontoken non-Angel creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1090-1692.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Restoration Angel with haste.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Angel you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Restoration Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.

692-1183-2034-4613.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-1183-2034-4613.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor by using Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
When the Pentavite enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Pentavites.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Wildwood Mentor using Pentavus's last ability any number of times.

1494-1841-1983-4017.notablePrerequisites: Sunbond attached to Sage of Hours.
1494-1841-1983-4017.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Force triggers, causing you to gain six life.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

479-1717-4958.notablePrerequisites:
Ludevic's Abomination has the greatest power among non-Human creatures you control.
You have no other cards in hand.
479-1717-4958.description:
Cast Return of the Wildspeaker by paying {4}{G}, causing you to draw thirteen cards.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.

851-2034-2198-2382.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3}, creating two token copies of Deceiver Exarch with haste.
The Deceiver Exarch tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Mimic Vat and any other permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Deceiver Exarch tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

565-1825-2450.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
565-1825-2450.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Treachery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, causing you to create a copy of Treachery and attach it to any creature.
The Treachery token enters the battlefield, causing you to untap up to five lands.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any other permanents you control in step 2 to get infinite token copies of them.

401-2034-5004.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
401-2034-5004.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and Decaying Soil.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Cathodion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat.

721-1338-2724.notablePrerequisites:
At least one additional card in hand.
Waterfront Bouncer does not have summoning sickness.
721-1338-2724.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Waterfront Bouncer by paying {U}, discarding a card, and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2548-5141.description:
Float at least {8}{W}{R}{R}.
Cast Teferi's Protection for {2}{W}, phasing out all of your permanents.
Cast Obliterate for {6}{R}{R}, destroying all lands, artifacts and creatures.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, your permanents phase back in.
